profile.readme:
# Grant Finder

## Overview

Finds open small-business grants in New Zealand that match your industry and region, with closing dates.

## Features

- Industry and region filters
- Closing dates

## How to use

Tell it your industry and region.

## Use cases

Sole traders, startups.

## Limitations

New Zealand only.
